kebab_example: aliyun ververica update-autopilot-policy --workspace a14bd5d90a0000 --namespace default-namespace --deployment-id 737d0921-c5ac-47fc-9ba9-07a1e0b40000 --enabled true --policy-config example-string --api-version 2022-07-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAutopilotPolicy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic tuning. A value of true enables automatic tuning (ACTIVE), and a value of false disables tuning (DISABLED). If this parameter is not specified, the current status is not changed
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动调优。true表示开启自动调优(ACTIVE)，false表示关闭调优(DISABLED)。不传则不修改当前状态
parameters.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The minimum cool-down time between two tuning operations, in minutes
fields.help_zh: 两次调优间最小冷却时间（分钟）
fields.name: cool_down_minutes

fields.help_en: The maximum CPU
fields.help_zh: 最大CPU
fields.name: job_max_cpu

fields.help_en: The maximum memory. Format examples: 4Gi, 256GiB
fields.help_zh: 最大内存，格式如 4 Gi、256GiB
fields.name: job_max_memory

fields.help_en: The maximum parallelism
fields.help_zh: 最大并行度
fields.name: job_max_parallelism

fields.help_en: The minimum parallelism
fields.help_zh: 最小并行度
fields.name: job_min_parallelism

fields.help_en: The upper and lower limits for tuning resources
fields.help_zh: 调优资源上下限
fields.name: limits

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable silent periods
fields.help_zh: 是否启用静默时段
fields.name: enabled

element_fields.help_en: The silent level. DAY indicates daily repetition. WEEK indicates weekly repetition
element_fields.help_zh: 静默级别。DAY表示按天重复，WEEK表示按周重复
element_fields.name: level

element_fields.help_en: The start time. For the DAY level: 0-1439, representing the minute offset of the day (for example, 540 represents 9:00). For the WEEK level: 1-7, representing the day of the week (ISO 8601, 1=Monday, 7=Sunday)
element_fields.help_zh: 起始时间。DAY级别：0-1439，表示当天分钟偏移量（如540表示9:00）；WEEK级别：1-7，表示星期几（ISO 8601，1=Monday，7=Sunday）
element_fields.name: begin_time

element_fields.help_en: The end time. The format is the same as beginTime. For the WEEK level, if endTime is less than beginTime, it indicates a cross-week period (for example, beginTime=6, endTime=2 means silent from Saturday to the following Tuesday)
element_fields.help_zh: 结束时间。格式同beginTime。WEEK级别下若endTime小于beginTime表示跨周（如beginTime=6, endTime=2表示周六到下周二静默）
element_fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The list of silent periods. This is a full replacement, not an append operation
fields.help_zh: 静默时段列表。整体替换，非追加
fields.name: silent_periods

fields.help_en: The silent period configuration. Automatic tuning operations are not performed during silent periods
fields.help_zh: 静默时段配置。静默时段内不执行自动调优操作
fields.name: silent_period_config

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable delay detection scale-up
fields.help_zh: 是否启用延迟检测扩容
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The delay sampling interval. Format examples: 3min, 5m, 1h
fields.help_zh: 延迟采样间隔，格式如 3min、5m、1h
fields.name: delay_sample_interval

fields.help_en: The latency threshold. Format examples: 1min, 10m. Scale-up is triggered when the delay continuously exceeds this threshold
fields.help_zh: 延迟阈值，格式如 1min、10m。当延迟持续超过该阈值时触发扩容
fields.name: delay_threshold

fields.help_en: The delay detection scale-up rule. Scale-up is triggered when the job delay exceeds the threshold
fields.help_zh: 延迟检测扩容规则。当作业延迟超过阈值时触发扩容
fields.name: delay_rule

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable slot busy scale-up
fields.help_zh: 是否启用Slot繁忙扩容
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The slot busy sampling interval. Format examples: 6min, 5m
fields.help_zh: Slot繁忙采样间隔，格式如 6min、5m
fields.name: slot_busy_scale_up_sample_interval

fields.help_en: The slot busy scale-up threshold. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. Scale-up is triggered when the slot busy ratio exceeds this value
fields.help_zh: Slot繁忙扩容阈值，取值范围0.0~1.0。当Slot繁忙比例超过该值时触发扩容
fields.name: slot_busy_scale_up_threshold

fields.help_en: The slot busy scale-up rule. Scale-up is triggered when the slot busy ratio exceeds the threshold
fields.help_zh: Slot繁忙扩容规则。当Slot繁忙比例超过阈值时触发扩容
fields.name: slot_busy_scale_up_rule

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable memory scale-up
fields.help_zh: 是否启用内存扩容
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The memory scale-up threshold. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. Scale-up is triggered when memory usage exceeds this value
fields.help_zh: 内存扩容阈值，取值范围0.0~1.0。当内存使用率超过该值时触发扩容
fields.name: mem_usage_scale_up_threshold

fields.help_en: The memory scale-up rule. Scale-up is triggered when memory usage exceeds the threshold
fields.help_zh: 内存扩容规则。当内存使用率超过阈值时触发扩容
fields.name: memory_scale_up_rule

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable OOM scale-up
fields.help_zh: 是否启用OOM扩容
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The OOM scale-up rule. Scale-up is triggered when an OOM risk is detected
fields.help_zh: OOM扩容规则。当检测到OOM风险时触发扩容
fields.name: oom_scale_up_rule

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable GC tuning
fields.help_zh: 是否启用GC调优
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The GC time ratio threshold. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. Scale-up is triggered when the GC time ratio exceeds this value
fields.help_zh: GC时间占比阈值，取值范围0.0~1.0。当GC时间占比超过该值时触发扩容
fields.name: gc_time_ratio_threshold

fields.help_en: The GC sampling interval. Format examples: 3min, 5m
fields.help_zh: GC采样间隔，格式如 3min、5m
fields.name: gc_sample_interval

fields.help_en: The GC tuning rule. Scale-up is triggered when the GC time ratio exceeds the threshold
fields.help_zh: GC调优规则。当GC时间占比超过阈值时触发扩容
fields.name: gc_rule

fields.help_en: The scale-up rule configuration
fields.help_zh: 扩容规则配置
fields.name: scale_up_rules

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable slot idle scale-down
fields.help_zh: 是否启用Slot空闲缩容
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The slot idle sampling interval. Format examples: 4h, 5m
fields.help_zh: Slot空闲采样间隔，格式如 4h、5m
fields.name: slot_busy_scale_down_sample_interval

fields.help_en: The slot idle scale-down threshold. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. Scale-down is triggered when the slot busy ratio falls below this value. This value must be less than the scale-up threshold
fields.help_zh: Slot空闲缩容阈值，取值范围0.0~1.0。当Slot繁忙比例低于该值时触发缩容。必须小于扩容阈值
fields.name: slot_busy_scale_down_threshold

fields.help_en: The slot idle scale-down rule. Scale-down is triggered when the slot busy ratio falls below the threshold
fields.help_zh: Slot空闲缩容规则。当Slot繁忙比例低于阈值时触发缩容
fields.name: slot_busy_scale_down_rule

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable memory scale-down
fields.help_zh: 是否启用内存缩容
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The memory scale-down threshold. Valid values: 0.0 to 1.0. Scale-down is triggered when memory usage falls below this value. This value must be less than the scale-up threshold
fields.help_zh: 内存缩容阈值，取值范围0.0~1.0。当内存使用率低于该值时触发缩容。必须小于扩容阈值
fields.name: mem_usage_scale_down_threshold

fields.help_en: The memory scale-down sampling interval. Format examples: 4h, 5m
fields.help_zh: 内存缩容采样间隔，格式如 4h、5m
fields.name: mem_usage_scale_down_sample_interval

fields.help_en: The memory scale-down rule. Scale-down is triggered when memory usage falls below the threshold
fields.help_zh: 内存缩容规则。当内存使用率低于阈值时触发缩容
fields.name: memory_scale_down_rule

fields.help_en: The scale-down rule configuration
fields.help_zh: 缩容规则配置
fields.name: scale_down_rules

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable advanced rules
fields.help_zh: 是否启用高级规则
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The advanced rule parameters. An empty map indicates that internal default parameters are used. You can override specific internal parameters by using key-value pairs. The entire map is replaced
fields.help_zh: 高级规则参数。空Map表示使用内部默认参数，用户可通过key-value覆盖特定内部参数。整体替换
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The advanced rule configuration. This includes advanced parameters such as chain-break optimization, minimum parallelism, and TM CPU scaling. Disabled by default and must be explicitly enabled
fields.help_zh: 高级规则配置。包含断链优化、最小并行度、TM CPU扩缩容等高级参数。默认关闭，需显式开启
fields.name: advanced_rules

parameters.help_en: The tuning policy configuration. This parameter uses full PUT mode: when specified, the complete policy object replaces the existing configuration entirely (fields not included are cleared). If this parameter is not specified, the existing configuration is retained
parameters.help_zh: 调优策略配置。采用全量 PUT 模式：传入时以完整的策略对象整体替换现有配置（未包含的字段将被清空）；不传该字段则保留现有配置不变
parameters.name: policy_config

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body for updating the tuning policy
v1_body_parameters.name: body
